newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: FORECAST - KOF says strong Sfr trims GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - KOF says strong Sfr trims GDP growth.

text.p: One of Switzerland's top three economic institutes on Wednesday blamed the strong Swiss franc for slow economic recovery and said the franc would remain high against major export currencies through 1998.
The KOF institute lowered its forecasts for 1996 and 1997 gross domestic product (GDP) in line with a series of downward revisions by most other economists.
"The factors responsible for this disappointing development are partly domestic...but largely the result of the noticeable appreciation of the Swiss franc," KOF said in its autumn report.
